ABOUT US

Thank you for visiting Suni Sands Curated Home, you have great taste!

We offer a beautiful + ever-changing collection of wares and treasures including:

  • Unique home decor to beautify your space
  • Gifts for your favorite humans and pets
  • Local artisan luxuries and pop-ups
  • A DIY plant bar for creating living art
  • Workshops for community gatherings + celebrations

Located in the landmark Dutcher House in Pawling’s downtown, we stand alongside an incredible array of restaurants, shops, and businesses.

We hope to see you around town!
